title: DNA Concentration Measurement
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.79khr4w

steps.title: Start Nanodrop software
steps.instruction: Open the ND‑1000 V3.8.1 program on a computer that is connected to the Nanodrop instrument.

steps.title: Select nucleic‑acid module
steps.instruction: Click the appropriate application module (e.g., “Nucleic acid”) to determine nucleic‑acid concentration and purity.

steps.title: Prepare and read blank
steps.instruction: Open the sampling arm, pipette 1.5 µL of a blank solution (e.g., TE buffer or MQ water) onto the upper and lower pedestals, close the arm, then click “OK” to read the blank.

steps.title: Clean pedestals after blank
steps.instruction: Open the sampling arm and wipe both pedestals with a Kim wipe to remove the blank.

steps.title: Load sample and measure
steps.instruction: Open the sampling arm, pipette 1.5 µL of DNA or RNA onto the pedestals, close the arm, select the sample type (DNA or RNA) in the program, and click “Measure”.

steps.title: Record absorbance and concentration
steps.instruction: When the measurement finishes, note the 260/280 ratio, 260/230 ratio, and the concentration in ng/µL.

steps.title: Clean pedestals after sample
steps.instruction: Wipe the upper and lower pedestals with a Kim wipe to remove the nucleic‑acid sample.

steps.title: Repeat for remaining samples
steps.instruction: Perform steps 3–7 for each additional sample.
